verdict.rationale: Bento is a SaaS observability platform that ingests customer traces, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence contains no such policy or control. The only training-related claim is that Bento trains detection signals on the customer's own traces, which is a product feature, not a guarantee that data is excluded from AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
